stage1.impression: A symmetrical, warm, fir-lined niche with two speakers on oak plinths in front of flat dark panels. The fir reads fairly well, but the speakers read as clear plastic boxes stuffed with bright white blocks, and two identical opaque white squares float on their upper corners. The foreground is a flat, toneless dark floor with a blurred grey disc of a lamp dead centre. The whole thing looks like a hi-fi showroom or home-cinema render, not a photograph of a specific bar: no concrete, beams or steel are in view and there's no sign of life to speak of. A magazine would not run it as a specific place; it reads as a generic listening niche.

blocking_9: The smoke tint must read at a glance on both speakers: the speaker region's r/g/b medians clearly tinted, not neutral grey (now R85 G74 B75), with the white batts no brighter than about 200 instead of 246
The floating opaque white squares on the speakers (278-330,320-385 and 830-896,320-385) must be gone or read as something real
The flat dark panels behind the speakers and the floor need texture, sheen and falloff that read as real materials at 1:1 rather than flat CG planes
The frame needs the shell (board-formed concrete, a fir beam, blackened steel) and a sign of life, so it reads as Planet EARF rather than a generic niche
The foreground Orb must glow as a lamp, not read as a grey blurred disc that blocks the axis to the altar

defects.what: Opaque near-white square (median 246) on the left speaker's upper-left corner. It looks pasted on or floating, and it is mirrored on the right speaker.
The same floating white square, mirrored on the right speaker. The repeated copy reads as CG.
The cabinet reads as clear, colourless plastic. The batts glow paper-white (p95 245) and the smoke tint is lost (R85 G74 B75).
Black resin horn with plastic-looking, wobbly highlights and a thin white rim line along its edge.
Flat, untextured dark-brown panels behind each speaker. They read as CG planes.
Featureless floor (median 19) with no visible grain, polish or pools of light. The step edge isn't legible.
The Orb in the foreground reads as a grey frosted disc (median 145, neutral) in out-of-focus mush and doesn't glow. Centred, it blocks the view of the altar.
Downlight hotspots on the fir soffit are near clipping (median 234).
The left edge is a dead void (median 9, crush 11.6 %). The shell isn't visible.
The seated guest is an unreadable dark blob cut by the frame edge. It isn't legible as a person.
Sleeve against the right plinth reads as a flat grey card.

changes.problem: The altar spots front-light the speakers so hard that the white batts blow out and the smoke tint disappears, so the hero reads as clear plastic.

evidence.measured: batt region median 150, p95 244. Floating square median 246. Speaker region R85 G74 B75 (neutral).

change.from: 50.0 W, 2500 K, cone 30.0 deg, aimed at the speakers
change.to: 20 W, 2500 K, cone 20 deg, aimed at the fir wall and the plinth tops beside the speakers so they are lit from behind and the side (grazing the cabinet edges)

changes.expected: The cabinets darken and the smoke tint shows through the acrylic. The batts fall to a soft grey glow behind the tint, and the polished edges pick up rim highlights.

changes.problem: The lamps on the speakers add flat frontal fill that flattens the acrylic and makes the horn read glossy plastic.

evidence.measured: horn shows broken, wobbly specular streaks and a white rim line. Speaker median 76 with lum_range 236.

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area
change.to: 0.15 W/m2, 2700 K, moved to a single large soft source high and to one side

changes.expected: One clean, broad reflection on the horn and the acrylic faces instead of streaks. The speaker stays readable at median 50 or more.

changes.problem: The camera is dead centre on the altar axis, so the foreground table and Orb block the view and the frame shows no shell, which makes it a generic symmetric niche.

evidence.measured: the Orb occupies the centre-bottom of the frame. Left and right edges are void (median 9 and 13).

change.to: position [11.4, 2.3, 1.05], target [16.5, 3.2, 1.05], 35 mm, so the Orb table sits in the lower-left third and a concrete wall or fir beam edge enters frame right

changes.expected: An asymmetric, seated view with the altar in the right-centre and the Orb as a foreground practical off-axis. The shell's concrete and beam are visible, so the frame reads as a specific place.

changes.problem: The Orb doesn't read as a lit lamp. It is a neutral grey disc lit from outside, not glowing from within.

evidence.measured: median 145, R150 G144 B133 (neutral), no falloff onto the table.

changes.expected: The Orb glows warm and smoky through its tint and casts a pool on the oak table. The table top near it lifts and falls off.

changes.problem: The floor and the dark panels behind the speakers are flat, toneless planes with no grain, sheen or pools of light.

evidence.measured: lum_range 19.6, median 15.8: no texture or reflection.

change.setting: the materials' finish: the floor's polish
change.to: satin polish (roughness about 0.35) so the altar spots and the Orbs leave soft reflected pools, plus a subtle wear and dust map

changes.expected: Soft reflections of the plinths and lamps in the floor and visible variation in tone, so the floor reads as a real surface.

changes.problem: The ceiling downlight hotspots on the fir are close to clipping and pull the eye off the speakers.

change.setting: lamps: the Domes' downlights / niche soffit spots

changes.expected: Soft scallops on the fir instead of hot spots. The brightest area in the frame moves to the speakers.

changes.problem: There is no legible sign of life: the guest is a cut-off dark blob, and the sleeve is a flat grey card.

change.from: 1 guest at the frame edge, 1 rocks
change.to: the guest moved into a tub chair in the mid-left, lit by an Orb, with the shoulder in motion blur. A half-drunk rocks glass and a record sleeve on the near table.

changes.expected: A blurred, warm-lit figure reads as a listener and adds scale. Props catch small highlights.

changes.problem: The frame edges are a dead void, so the room has no shell and the frame's shadows hold no detail.

change.setting: haze in the room's air plus a record-wall or concrete wash
change.from: haze 0.004, no wash on the side walls
change.to: haze 0.008 and one 4 W, 2600 K wall grazer on the board-formed concrete at frame left

changes.expected: The concrete's boards and tie holes appear faintly at the left edge, and a little atmosphere separates the altar from the room.

out_of_scope.request: Remove or explain the opaque white square on each speaker's upper corner
out_of_scope.why: It is part of the speaker model (its parts are fixed). If it is a modelling error, such as a batt poking through the acrylic, it needs fixing in the product model, not the scene.

out_of_scope.request: A stronger, more legible smoke tint in the cabinet acrylic
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour is fixed. Only the light (c1, c2) may reveal it.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the flat dark panels behind the speakers with something with texture
out_of_scope.why: They are part of the altar's design as the card fixes it. Only their finish could change, and the card doesn't name them.
